name: Historical Sites
description: Temples, royal capitals and ruins from twelve centuries of Khmer history.

description: Museums, living crafts, indigenous communities and the arts of modern Cambodia.

name: National Parks
description: Protected forest, wildlife sanctuaries, and highland plateaus.

name: Luxury Hotel
description: Five-star stays from the gulf islands to the Bokor plateau.

name: Homestay
description: Sleep in a village house and live the local rhythm.

name: Resorts
description: Resort stays with a pool, a spa or a golf course close by.

name: Eco Lodge
description: Low-impact lodges run with the communities around them.

description: Khmer kitchens and fine dining worth planning a day around.

description: Noodle stalls, grills and riverfront snacks.

description: Nights in the forest and under the highland sky.

description: Markets, craft quarters and the capital's shopping streets.

description: Food trails to cook, taste and shop the Khmer table, from the market to the farm.
